statement: For the frozen finite carrier plus separate vacuum and one neutral record, derive both complete Hamiltonians H_P=K+N-g P tensor X from the signed controls with one common empty-reference subtraction, for P=Pi and P=c-Pi. Establish rather than assume that the frozen K preserves these sectors, derive the exact block dynamics and conserved sector observables, and exhibit an admitted same-input readout discriminator at the frozen time.

outcome_ports.++: A complete source-pinned reviewed theorem bundle proves the umbrella. Each named conclusion still requires a nonce-bound scoped receipt and its existing prerequisites.
outcome_ports.+-: Incomplete proof leaves the theorem and unadmitted conclusions unresolved.
outcome_ports.-+: A scoped counterexample must identify the failed hypothesis or conclusion. No automatic downstream refutation; use existing claim-scoped rejection admission.
outcome_ports.--: An unsuccessful rejection changes no scientific outcome.

planning_policy: Shared proof route, not an independent truth prior or new budget action. Reuse one theorem evidence identity through the three existing conclusion actions. Existing action costs remain unchanged; no claimed bundle-cost optimization.
admission_policy: No automatic promotion of conclusions, comparison or physical admission. A failed check is not a refutation. Proof bundles must establish every listed assumption and conclusion under the frozen contract; assuming commutation is insufficient.
